invariants: Every accepted disciple receives a stable persistent identity core.
Numeric capabilities and learning aptitudes resolve deterministically per roster slot; cohort summaries are simulation/storage layers, not substitute characters.

Promotion to a heavyweight exact character must preserve the same person ID, identity, established individualized capability values, learning aptitudes, cohort/intake provenance, affiliations, and accumulated history.
Exact promotion must not reroll or regenerate an established disciple.
